# PhysicsService

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- A **service**: get it with `game:GetService("PhysicsService")`
- **Not creatable**: it cannot be created with `Instance.new`

Holds the simulation's tick length and the physics settings that do not belong to a single part, such as collision groups.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `FixedTimestep` | `number` | `1/60` | read/write | The length of one simulation tick, in seconds. The default is 1/60. Every timer counts in ticks: `task.wait(1)` is exactly 60 ticks at the default, on every machine and in every run. Code that expresses durations as multiples of this value works at any tick rate.<br><br>A new value takes effect at the start of the next frame. Setting a value outside 1/240 to 1/30 raises an error. |

## Methods

### `CollisionGroupSetCollidable(a: string, b: string, collidable: boolean)`

Sets whether parts in two groups collide with each other. The setting is symmetric: setting it for a and b also sets it for b and a.

### `GetRegisteredCollisionGroups(): {string}`

Returns the names of every registered group as a new array, in the order they were registered, with `Default` first.

### `RegisterCollisionGroup(name: string)`

Registers a collision group. A new group collides with every group until `CollisionGroupSetCollidable` says otherwise. Registering a name that already exists does nothing, so a script can register its groups every time it starts.
